steps.title: Bem-vindo: Sports - Volume 15
steps.text: In this A2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Sports". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: I've been a fan of this team since I was a kid.

My teammate passed me the ball.
